Discover the race A Bostik representative addressing a group of participants during a community event held outdoors. Recognized innovation powering the future of hygiene Bostik has been honored at the INDEX™ 26 Awards for Kizen® Miles 9.0, a breakthrough adhesive designed to advance both performance and sustainability in hygiene applications. By enabling efficient material separation at end-of-life and incorporating renewable content, this innovation supports the development of high-performing products aligned with circular economy goals. Discover the innovation A person holding an open plastic food container filled with fresh blueberries outdoors, with a glowing edge highlighting the packaging.
